Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. National Gay and Lesbian Task Force reduces its debt in half over the course of six months 2. Proliferation of bumper stickers in Chicago reading "Stop AIDS, Castrate Gays" COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 3. London, formation of Lesbians and Gays Support the Print Workers to take on Rupert Murdoch 4. Andy Humm on the division of gays during the conference for the March on Washington DC COMMERCIAL: Stamp Out AIDS featuring Jennifer Bassey 5. California, gay father given equal time to respond to 700 Club member's accusations of lewdness and child abuse 6. Washington, DC, coverage of politics and clips of openly gay politicians discussing the gay and lesbian political agenda COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 7. Seattle, Washington, 3 of 5 TV stations refuse to air AIDS awareness announcement 8. Study finds that 3/4ths of the people with CMV strain of AIDS show improvement after treatment with the experimental drug DHPG 9. Congress refuses to overturn Washington D.C.'s AIDS insurance law prohibiting providers from testing for AIDS infection prior to insurance approval 10. Sports Report, with clips from film, "American Anthem" 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, with clips from "LA Law" about an AIDS victim, and interview with culinary writer Sara Friedman, on wild mushrooms COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of "Oh, Coward!" Broadway revue
